description: Curated governance manifest for RG-131 control-viewer observation gate. One representative per document class, covering scanned, rotated, encrypted, malformed, handwritten, mixed-content, large, form, geometry, and text-only classes.

fixtures.description: Standard AcroForm with 6 widgets (text, checkbox, radio, choice, signature, date)
Scanned document with noise artifacts — tests OCR-only content
Clean scanned English text — baseline OCR quality
Scanned certificate with rotation — tests rotated scanned content
Widget form rotated 90° — tests rotation coordinate integrity
Mixed rotation across pages — tests multi-page rotation
Hybrid text+raster rotated 90° — tests cross-type rotation
AES-256 encrypted with user password — tests password handling
Encrypted hybrid text+raster — tests encrypted cross-type content
Truncated to 128 bytes — tests catastrophic malformation
Hybrid document truncated mid-stream — tests partial malformation
Simulated handwritten entries on a form — tests handwriting-like content
Text + raster + form fields — tests cross-type mixed content
3-page mixed layout document — tests multi-page mixed content
40-page hybrid document — tests large document handling
Complex form layout — tests non-standard form structure
Geometry PDF with tall-narrow page, rotation, and crop box — tests unusual page geometry
Navigation PDF with outlines, links, and missing destinations — tests link handling
Plain text with headings, paragraphs, and accented characters — tests text extraction
Two-column landscape with sidebar — tests column layout detection
Dense grid layout — tests high-density content
Sparse text layout — tests low-density content
Document with headers and footers — tests header/footer detection
Landscape page with chart — tests landscape orientation
Graphics-heavy document — tests visual content dominance
